variants.headline: Building finished and handed over
variants.body: The builder {builder} has finished and handed over {project}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Delivery reached; opening follows
variants.body: The project {project} has been completed and handed over by {builder}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A completed project leaves the builder's hands
variants.body: Completion and handover of {project} have been achieved by {builder}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
